functions.name: FMemory_QuantizeSize

functions.name: TArray8_ResizeGrow
functions.evidence: TArray with 8-byte elements (Data +0, ArrayNum +8, ArrayMax +0xc; byte counts use <<3). New capacity: max(1, ArrayNum) when ArrayMax is 0, otherwise ArrayNum + 3/8 of ArrayNum (integer). Allocated size from FMemory_QuantizeSize (0x142bfce10), capacity = size>>3 clamped to 0x7fffffff, then FMemory_Realloc (0x142bfd200). Same shape as TArray::ResizeGrow (Core/Public/Containers/Array.h).
functions.source: TArray<T>::ResizeGrow(int32 OldNum) for 8-byte elements (6638 call sites)

functions.name: TArray16_ShrinkIfSparse
functions.evidence: TArray with 16-byte elements (<<4 byte counts). Reallocates to ArrayNum (QuantizeSize, then Realloc) only when the slack exceeds 0x3fff bytes or ArrayNum*3 < ArrayMax*2 (2/3 rule). Not a direct UE 4.25 name; the exact call site is in TArray::RemoveAt slack handling.

functions.name: TInlineAllocator4_ResizeAllocation16

Realloc through FMemory_Realloc when the capacity changes (this+0x40 heap pointer, this+0x4c capacity). Called once: the copy-on-stack TArray in FUN_1406a9dc0.
functions.signature: void TInlineAllocator4_ResizeAllocation16(void* this, uint32 NewMax, uint32 PrevMax)

functions.name: FWeakObjectPtr_Get
functions.evidence: FUObjectArray lookup: index in [0, NumElements) (_DAT_148263a2c), chunk table _DAT_148263a18, 64K elements per chunk (>>0x10), 24-byte FUObjectItem (*0x18). Serial at item+0x10 must equal the weak pointer serial (param+4). Returns item->Object only if flags (item+8) & 0x30000000 (PendingKill|Unreachable) is zero; otherwise null. This is FWeakObjectPtr::Get(false).

functions.name: FWeakObjectPtr_GetEvenIfPendingKill
functions.evidence: Same lookup as FWeakObjectPtr_Get. When bEvenIfPendingKill is false the flag test is (flags & 0x30000000)==0; when true only the Unreachable bit (0x10000000) is checked. Returns the object or null. 45 call sites.

functions.name: FWeakObjectPtr_IsValid
functions.evidence: Same chunk lookup and serial check as FWeakObjectPtr_Get; returns true when the item exists, the serial matches and (flags & 0x30000000)==0. Serial zero returns false (item-less weak pointer). 3597 call sites.
